item.title: How NAU is making grad school more affordable
item.description: Building on the success of the Western Undergraduate Exchange (WUE) program, which offers out-of-state students from select states and territories a significant discount on tuition, NAU is now making similar moves for grad students. The Western Regional Graduate Program (WRGP) will launch in Fall 2026, significantly increasing affordable access to graduate school for students throughout the western United States.
